name: Shadow Appearance Swap
description: Shadow Mode route 2 smoke test, revision 2. Creature 0 takes Shadow's name, 3D appearance and character-profile art. The dialogue portrait prefix is deliberately LEFT as Sonic's: Shadow's portrait sets cover only 4 (PRTL_SDW) or 9 (PRTL_SHD) expressions against Sonic's 10, so pointing dialogue at them makes the game request art that does not exist and render corruption. Gameplay (stats, POW moves, progression, abilities) stays Sonic's.
